c.title: $4,950 / 3br - 1982ft2 - Spacious 3BR/1.5BA Dunbar Character Home | Mountain View/Private Yard (Vancouver)
c.description:
Situated in Vancouver's highly sought-after Dunbar neighbourhood, this charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom detached home offers a wonderful combination of space, privacy, and character. Located on a quiet, tree-lined residential street, the property provides a peaceful setting while remaining conveniently close to UBC, public transit, parks, shopping, and other amenities.

Offering approximately 2,000 sq. ft. of above-ground living space, the home features generous living and dining areas, large windows that bring in plenty of natural light, and a comfortable layout with room to spread out. The main floor includes a spacious living room with a fireplace, a separate dining room, a kitchen with a large central island and ample cabinetry, and an additional bright family room overlooking the backyard.

The property also offers excellent outdoor space, with multiple spacious decks and a private backyard surrounded by mature trees and greenery. Beautiful mountain and city views can be enjoyed from the upper level. The home has recently been refreshed with new interior paint and improvements to the outdoor areas, including a renovated deck.

With its generous living spaces, private outdoor areas, and convenient west-side location, this home offers a great opportunity to enjoy detached-house living in one of Vancouver's most established neighbourhoods.
